title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六 肅宗 代宗
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六 肅宗 代宗 Volume 6 Annals 6: Suzong, Daizong

sentences.zh: __FORCETOC__肅宗肅宗文明武德大聖大宣孝皇帝諱亨，玄宗第三子也。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__Emperor Suzong, Emperor Suzong the Civil and Martial, Great Sage and Great Proclaiming Filial, taboo name Heng, was the third son of Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__Emperor Suzong, posthumously honored as the Civil and Martial, Great Sage and Great Proclaiming Filial, bore the taboo name Heng and was the third son of Xuanzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰元獻皇后楊氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Yuanxian of the Yang clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Yuanxian, née Yang.

sentences.zh: 初名嗣昇，封陝王。

translations.literal: His original name was Sisheng; he was enfeoffed as Prince of Shan.
translations.idiomatic: He was first named Sisheng and enfeoffed as Prince of Shan.

sentences.zh: 開元四年，為安西大都護。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kaiyuan he was made great protector of Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan 4 he was appointed great protector of Anxi.

sentences.zh: 性仁孝，好學，玄宗尤愛之，遣賀知章、潘肅、呂向、皇甫彬、邢璹等侍讀左右。

translations.literal: By nature he was benevolent and filial and fond of learning; Xuanzong loved him especially and sent He Zhizhang, Pan Su, Lü Xiang, Huangfu Bin, Xing Shou, and others to attend him in study at his side.
translations.idiomatic: He was by nature benevolent, filial, and devoted to learning. Xuanzong favored him above all and assigned He Zhizhang, Pan Su, Lü Xiang, Huangfu Bin, Xing Shou, and others to tutor him at court.

sentences.zh: 十五年，更名浚，徙封忠王，為朔方節度大使、單于大都護。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year his name was changed to Jun; his fief was moved to Prince of Zhong, and he was made military commissioner of Shuofang and great protector of the Chanyu court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was renamed Jun, transferred to Prince of Zhong, and appointed military commissioner of Shuofang and great protector of the Chanyu court.

sentences.zh: 十八年，奚、契丹寇邊，乃以肅宗為河北道行軍元帥，遣御史大夫李朝隱等八總管兵十萬以伐之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Xi and Khitan raided the frontier; Suzong was then made campaign marshal of the Hebei circuit and eight commanders-in-chief including the censor-in-chief Li Chaoyin were sent with one hundred thousand troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the Xi and Khitan raided the border, he was made campaign marshal of the Hebei circuit. The censor-in-chief Li Chaoyin and seven other commanders-in-chief were dispatched with one hundred thousand men to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 居二歲，朝隱等敗奚、契丹於范陽北，肅宗以統帥功遷司徒。

translations.literal: After two years Chaoyin and the others defeated the Xi and Khitan north of Fanyang, and Suzong was promoted to grand mentor for his merit as supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Chaoyin and the others defeated the Xi and Khitan north of Fanyang, and Suzong was promoted to grand mentor for his merit as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，又更名璵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year his name was again changed to Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was again renamed Yu.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，皇太子瑛廢死，明年，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Crown Prince Ying was deposed and died; the next year he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Crown Prince Ying was deposed and put to death; the following year he was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 有司行冊禮，其儀有中嚴、外辦，其服絳紗。

translations.literal: The relevant offices performed the investiture rites; the ceremony included inner vigilance and outer preparation, and the garb was crimson gauze.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices performed the investiture rites, which prescribed inner vigilance and outer preparation and crimson gauze robes.

sentences.zh: 太子曰：「此天子禮也。

translations.literal: The crown prince said: "This is the Son of Heaven's ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince said, "These are the Son of Heaven's rites.

sentences.zh: 」乃下公卿議。

translations.literal: " He then submitted the matter to the dukes and ministers for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " He then referred the matter to the dukes and ministers for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 太師蕭嵩、左丞相裴耀卿請改「外辦」為「外備」，絳紗衣為朱明服，乃從之。

translations.literal: Grand preceptor Xiao Song and left chief minister Pei Yaoxing requested changing "outer preparation" to "outer readiness" and crimson gauze robes to vermilion-bright robes, and this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Xiao Song and left chief minister Pei Yaoxing asked that "outer preparation" be changed to "outer readiness" and crimson gauze robes to vermilion-bright robes, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，又更名紹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year his name was again changed to Shao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was again renamed Shao.

sentences.zh: 天寶三載，又更名亨。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianbao his name was again changed to Heng.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao 3 he was again renamed Heng.

sentences.zh: 安祿山來朝，太子識其有反相，請以罪誅之，玄宗不聽。

translations.literal: When An Lushan came to court the crown prince recognized in him the signs of rebellion and asked that he be put to death for his crimes, but Xuanzong would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: When An Lushan came to court, the crown prince saw in him the signs of rebellion and asked that he be executed for his crimes, but Xuanzong refused.

sentences.zh: 祿山反。

translations.literal: Lushan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Lushan rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 十五載，玄宗避賊，行至馬嵬，父老遮道請留太子討賊，玄宗許之，遣壽王瑁及內侍高力士諭太子，太子乃還。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Xuanzong fled the rebels; when he reached Mawei the elders blocked the road and begged that the crown prince be left to suppress the rebels; Xuanzong consented and sent Prince Shou Mao and the inner attendant Gao Lishi to instruct the crown prince, and the crown prince then returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Xuanzong fled the rebels. At Mawei the elders blocked the road and begged that the crown prince be left behind to suppress the bandits. Xuanzong agreed and sent Prince Shou Mao and the eunuch Gao Lishi to instruct the crown prince, who then turned back.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，至渭北便橋，橋絕，募水濱居民得三千餘人，涉而濟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day dingyou he reached Bian Bridge on the north bank of the Wei; the bridge was broken, and he recruited more than three thousand riverside residents and waded across.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on dingyou he reached Bian Bridge on the north bank of the Wei. The bridge was gone, so he recruited more than three thousand riverside residents and waded the army across.

sentences.zh: 遇潼關散卒，以為賊，與戰，多傷，既而覺之，收其餘以涉，後軍多沒者。

translations.literal: He encountered scattered troops from Tong Pass, took them for rebels, and fought them; many were wounded; afterward he realized the mistake, gathered the survivors to cross, and many in the rear guard were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: He met scattered troops from Tong Pass, mistook them for rebels, and fought them; many were wounded. When he realized the error he gathered the survivors to cross, but many in the rear guard were drowned.

sentences.zh: 夕次永壽縣，吏民稍持牛酒來獻。

translations.literal: In the evening he halted at Yongshou county, and officials and people gradually brought oxen and wine as offerings.
translations.idiomatic: That evening he halted at Yongshou county, where officials and commoners gradually brought oxen and wine as offerings.

sentences.zh: 新平郡太守薛羽、保定郡太守徐瑴聞賊且至，皆棄城走。

translations.literal: Xinping prefect Xue Yu and Baoding prefect Xu E, hearing that rebels were about to arrive, both abandoned their cities and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xinping prefect Xue Yu and Baoding prefect Xu E, hearing that rebels were approaching, both abandoned their cities and fled.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太子次保定，捕得羽、瑴，斬之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai the crown prince halted at Baoding, captured Yu and E, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the crown prince halted at Baoding, captured Yu and E, and had them executed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，次平涼郡，得牧馬牛羊，兵始振。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou he halted at Pingliang prefecture, obtained pasture horses and cattle, and the army's spirits began to revive.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he halted at Pingliang prefecture, obtained pasture horses and cattle, and the army's morale began to revive.

sentences.zh: 朔方留後支度副使杜鴻漸、六城水陸運使魏少游、節度判官崔漪、支度判官崔簡金、關內鹽池判官李涵、河西行軍司馬裴冕迎太子治兵于朔方。

translations.literal: Shuofang acting commissioner and deputy commissioner of support Du Hongjian, Six Cities land-and-water transport commissioner Wei Shaoyou, military affairs judge Cui Yi, support judge Cui Jianjin, Guannei salt-pond judge Li Han, and Hexi campaign marshal Pei Mian welcomed the crown prince to drill troops at Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: Shuofang acting commissioner and deputy support commissioner Du Hongjian, Six Cities transport commissioner Wei Shaoyou, military affairs judge Cui Yi, support judge Cui Jianjin, Guannei salt-pond judge Li Han, and Hexi campaign marshal Pei Mian welcomed the crown prince to drill troops at Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，次豐寧，見大河之險，將保之，會天大風，迴趨靈武。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu he halted at Fengning, saw the Yellow River's perilous banks and was about to hold them, but a great wind arose from heaven and he turned back toward Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he halted at Fengning. Seeing the Yellow River's dangerous banks he was about to hold position there, but a great wind arose and he turned back toward Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，至于靈武。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day xinyou he arrived at Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinyou he arrived at Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，裴冕等請皇太子即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Pei Mian and others requested that the crown prince immediately take the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Pei Mian and others asked that the crown prince immediately ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲子，即皇帝位于靈武，尊皇帝曰上皇天帝，大赦，改元至德。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi he took the throne at Lingwu, honored the emperor as Retired Emperor of Heaven, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Zhide.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he ascended the throne at Lingwu, honored the emperor as Retired Emperor of Heaven, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Zhide.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵，版授侍老太守、縣令。

translations.literal: He bestowed ranks, merit registers, and titles on civil and military officials and issued provisional appointments of prefects and magistrates to elderly worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He bestowed ranks, merit registers, and titles on civil and military officials and issued provisional appointments of prefects and magistrates to elderly worthies.

sentences.zh: 裴冕為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Pei Mian was made vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Mian was appointed vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，安祿山寇扶風，太守薛景仙敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu An Lushan raided Fufeng; prefect Xue Jingxian defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu An Lushan raided Fufeng; prefect Xue Jingxian defeated him.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，張巡及安祿山將李廷望戰于雍丘，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day xinmao Zhang Xun and An Lushan's general Li Tingwang fought at Yongqiu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinmao Zhang Xun and An Lushan's general Li Tingwang fought at Yongqiu and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the first day xinsi there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on the new moon of xinsi there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸未，次彭原郡。

translations.literal: On the day guimao he halted at Pengyuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he halted at Pengyuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔御史諫官論事勿先白大夫及宰相。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that censor-remonstrators discussing affairs must not first report to the grand censor or the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: It was decreed that remonstrating censors must not first report to the grand censor or the chief ministers when presenting business.

sentences.zh: 始鬻爵、度僧尼。

translations.literal: Sale of offices and ordination of monks and nuns began.
translations.idiomatic: The sale of offices and ordination of monks and nuns began.

sentences.zh: 房琯為招討西京、防禦蒲潼兩關兵馬元帥，兵部尚書王思禮副之。

translations.literal: Fang Guan was made campaign marshal for the Western Capital and defender of the Pu and Tong passes; Minister of War Wang Sili was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guan was made campaign marshal for the Western Capital and defender of the Pu and Tong passes, with Minister of War Wang Sili as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 南軍入于宜壽，中軍入于武功，北軍入于奉天。

translations.literal: The southern army entered Yishou, the central army entered Wugong, and the northern army entered Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: The southern army entered Yishou, the central army Wugong, and the northern army Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，河南節度副使張巡及令狐潮戰于雍丘，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Henan deputy military commissioner Zhang Xun and Linghu Chao fought at Yongqiu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Henan deputy military commissioner Zhang Xun and Linghu Chao fought at Yongqiu and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，房琯以中軍、北軍及安祿山之眾戰于陳濤斜，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Fang Guan with the central and northern armies and An Lushan's forces fought at Chen-Tao Slope and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Fang Guan led the central and northern armies against An Lushan's forces at Chen-Tao Slope and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，琯又以南軍戰，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Guan again fought with the southern army and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Guan fought again with the southern army and was again defeated.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣永王璘朝上皇天帝于蜀郡。

translations.literal: That month Prince Yong Li was sent to attend upon the Retired Emperor of Heaven in Shu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince Yong Li was sent to attend upon the Retired Emperor of Heaven in Shu.

sentences.zh: 璘反，丹徒郡太守閻敬之及璘戰于伊婁埭，死之。

translations.literal: Li rebelled; Dantu prefect Yan Jingzhi fought Li at Yilou Embankment and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Li rebelled. Dantu prefect Yan Jingzhi fought Li at Yilou Embankment and was killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，河西地震。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day xinhai there was an earthquake in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on xinhai there was an earthquake in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，崔渙為江南宣慰使。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Cui Huan was made commissioner to console Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Cui Huan was appointed commissioner to console Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 郭子儀率回紇及安祿山戰于河上，敗之。

translations.literal: Guo Ziyi led the Uyghurs and fought An Lushan on the Yellow River and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi led the Uyghurs and fought An Lushan on the Yellow River and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 史思明寇太原。

translations.literal: Shi Siming raided Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Siming raided Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，安祿山陷魯、東平、濟陰三郡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month An Lushan captured the three prefectures of Lu, Dongping, and Jiyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month An Lushan captured the three prefectures of Lu, Dongping, and Jiyin.

sentences.zh: 戊子，給復彭原郡二載。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi tax and corvée obligations were remitted for Pengyuan prefecture for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi tax and corvée were remitted for Pengyuan prefecture for two years.

sentences.zh: 安祿山陷潁川，執太守薛愿及長史龐堅。

translations.literal: An Lushan captured Yingchuan and seized prefect Xue Yuan and chief administrator Pang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: An Lushan captured Yingchuan and seized prefect Xue Yuan and chief administrator Pang Jian.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐蕃陷巂州，嶺南溪獠梁崇牽陷容州。

translations.literal: That year Tubo captured Xizhou, and the Lingnan Xi chieftain Liang Chongqian captured Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tubo captured Xizhou, and the Lingnan Xi chieftain Liang Chongqian captured Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 二載正月，永王璘陷鄱陽郡。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Prince Yong Li captured Poyang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Prince Yong Li captured Poyang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，安慶緒弒其父祿山。

translations.literal: On the day yimao An Qingxu murdered his father Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao An Qingxu murdered his father Lushan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，河西兵馬使孟庭倫殺其節度使周佖，以武威郡反。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Hexi military commissioner Meng Tinglun killed his military commissioner Zhou Yi and rebelled with Wuwei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Hexi military commissioner Meng Tinglun killed his military commissioner Zhou Yi and rebelled from Wuwei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，安慶緒將尹子奇寇睢陽郡，張巡敗之。

translations.literal: On the day yihai An Qingxu's general Yin Ziqi raided Suiyang prefecture; Zhang Xun defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai An Qingxu's general Yin Ziqi raided Suiyang prefecture; Zhang Xun defeated him.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，次于鳳翔。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day wuzi he halted at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on wuzi he halted at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 李光弼及安慶緒之眾戰于太原，敗之。

translations.literal: Li Guangbi and An Qingxu's forces fought at Taiyuan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangbi and An Qingxu's forces fought at Taiyuan and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，關西節度兵馬使郭英乂及安慶緒戰于武功，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou Guanxi military commissioner Guo Yingyi and An Qingxu fought at Wugong and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Guanxi military commissioner Guo Yingyi and An Qingxu fought at Wugong and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 慶緒陷馮翊郡，太守蕭賁死之。

translations.literal: Qingxu captured Fengyi prefecture; prefect Xiao Ben was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Qingxu captured Fengyi prefecture; prefect Xiao Ben was killed.

sentences.zh: 慶緒將蔡希德寇太原。

translations.literal: Qingxu's general Cai Xide raided Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Qingxu's general Cai Xide raided Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，庶人璘伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu the commoner Li was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the deposed Prince Li was executed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，郭子儀及安慶緒戰于潼關，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Guo Ziyi and An Qingxu fought at Tong Pass and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Guo Ziyi and An Qingxu fought at Tong Pass and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，河西判官崔偁克武威郡，孟庭倫伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Hexi judge Cui Cheng captured Wuwei prefecture; Meng Tinglun was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Hexi judge Cui Cheng captured Wuwei prefecture; Meng Tinglun was executed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，郭子儀及安慶緒戰于永豐倉，敗之，大將李韶光、王祚死之。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Guo Ziyi and An Qingxu fought at Yongfeng Granary and defeated him; generals Li Shaoguang and Wang Zuo were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Guo Ziyi and An Qingxu fought at Yongfeng Granary and defeated him; generals Li Shaoguang and Wang Zuo were killed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，韋見素、裴冕罷。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day xinyou Wei Jiansu and Pei Mian were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinyou Wei Jiansu and Pei Mian were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 憲部尚書致仕苗晉卿為左相。

translations.literal: Retired Minister of Justice Miao Jinqing was made left chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Minister of Justice Miao Jinqing was appointed left chief minister.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，郭子儀為關內、河東副元帥。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day wuyin Guo Ziyi was made deputy supreme commander of Guannei and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on wuyin Guo Ziyi was made deputy supreme commander of Guannei and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 壬午，瘞陣亡者。

translations.literal: On the day renwu the fallen in battle were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the war dead were buried.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，郭子儀及安慶緒將李歸仁戰于劉運橋，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Guo Ziyi and An Qingxu's general Li Guiren fought at Liuyun Bridge and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Guo Ziyi and An Qingxu's general Li Guiren fought at Liuyun Bridge and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，子儀及慶緒將安守忠戰于清渠，敗績。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day guichou Ziyi and Qingxu's general An Shouzhong fought at Qingqu and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on guichou Ziyi and Qingxu's general An Shouzhong fought at Qingqu and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，房琯罷，諫議大夫張鎬為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Fang Guan was dismissed; remonstrating censor Zhang Hao was made vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Fang Guan was dismissed; remonstrating censor Zhang Hao was appointed vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，尹子奇寇睢陽。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guimao Yin Ziqi raided Suiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guimao Yin Ziqi raided Suiyang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，南充郡民何滔執其太守楊齊曾以反，劍南節度使盧元裕敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou Nanchong commoner He Tao seized his prefect Yang Qizeng in rebellion; Jiannan military commissioner Lu Yuanyu defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Nanchong commoner He Tao seized his prefect Yang Qizeng in rebellion; Jiannan military commissioner Lu Yuanyu defeated him.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，太白經天。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiyou Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiyou Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，安慶緒將安武臣陷陝郡。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi An Qingxu's general An Wuchen captured Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi An Qingxu's general An Wuchen captured Shan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，焚長春宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day dingchou Changchun Palace was burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on dingchou Changchun Palace was burned.

sentences.zh: 甲申，崔渙罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Cui Huan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Cui Huan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 張鎬兼河南節度使，都統淮南諸軍事。

translations.literal: Zhang Hao was additionally Henan military commissioner and supreme commander of Huainan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hao was additionally made Henan military commissioner and supreme commander of Huainan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 靈昌郡太守許叔冀奔于彭城。

translations.literal: Lingchang prefect Xu Shuji fled to Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Lingchang prefect Xu Shuji fled to Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day guisi a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi a grand review was held.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅，安慶緒寇好畤，渭北節度使李光進敗之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day jiayin An Qingxu raided Hao, and Weibei military commissioner Li Guangjin defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on jiayin An Qingxu raided Hao; Weibei military commissioner Li Guangjin defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，廣平郡王俶為天下兵馬元帥，郭子儀副之，以朔方、安西、回紇、南蠻、大食兵討安慶緒。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Prince of Guangping Chu was made supreme commander of all armies; Guo Ziyi was his deputy, and with Shuofang, Anxi, Uyghur, Nanman, and Dashi troops he campaigned against An Qingxu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Prince of Guangping Chu was made supreme commander of all armies with Guo Ziyi as deputy, and with Shuofang, Anxi, Uyghur, Nanman, and Dashi troops campaigned against An Qingxu.

sentences.zh: 辛未，京畿採訪宣慰使崔光遠及慶緒戰于駱谷，敗之；

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Metropolitan Reconnaissance and Consolation Commissioner Cui Guangyuan and Qingxu fought at Luogu and defeated him;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Metropolitan Reconnaissance and Consolation Commissioner Cui Guangyuan and Qingxu fought at Luogu and defeated him;

sentences.zh: 行軍司馬王伯倫戰于苑北，死之。

translations.literal: campaign marshal Wang Bolun fought north of the park and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: campaign marshal Wang Bolun fought north of the Imperial Park and was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，慶緒陷上黨郡，執節度使程千里。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day dingchou Qingxu captured Shangdang prefecture and seized military commissioner Cheng Qianli.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dingchou Qingxu captured Shangdang prefecture and seized military commissioner Cheng Qianli.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，廣平郡王俶及慶緒戰于灃水，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Prince of Guangping Chu and Qingxu fought at Feng River and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince of Guangping Chu and Qingxu fought at Feng River and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，復京師。

translations.literal: On the day guimao the capital was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the capital was recovered.

sentences.zh: 慶緒奔于陝郡。

translations.literal: Qingxu fled to Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qingxu fled to Shan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射裴冕告太清宮、郊廟、社稷、五陵，宣慰百姓。

translations.literal: Left vice director Pei Mian announced the Grand Supreme Shrine, suburban altars, state altars, and the five imperial tombs and consoled the people.
translations.idiomatic: Left vice director Pei Mian announced the Grand Supreme Shrine, suburban altars, state altars, and the five imperial tombs and consoled the people.

sentences.zh: 十月戊申，廣平郡王俶及安慶緒戰于新店，敗之，克陝郡。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day wushen Prince of Guangping Chu and An Qingxu fought at Xindian and defeated him, capturing Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on wushen Prince of Guangping Chu and An Qingxu fought at Xindian, defeated him, and captured Shan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬子，復東京，慶緒奔于河北。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the Eastern Capital was recovered; Qingxu fled to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Eastern Capital was recovered; Qingxu fled to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 興平軍兵馬使李奐及慶緒之眾戰于武關，敗之，克上洛郡。

translations.literal: Xingping Army military commissioner Li Huan and Qingxu's forces fought at Wu Pass and defeated them, capturing Shangluo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xingping Army military commissioner Li Huan and Qingxu's forces fought at Wu Pass, defeated them, and captured Shangluo prefecture.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃陷西平郡。

translations.literal: Tubo captured Xiping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tubo captured Xiping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，安慶緒陷睢陽，太守許遠及張巡、鄆州刺史姚誾、左金吾衞將軍南霽雲皆死之。

translations.literal: On the day guichou An Qingxu captured Suiyang; prefect Xu Yuan, Zhang Xun, Yanzhou prefect Yao Yin, and Left Golden Canopy Guard general Nan Jiyun were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou An Qingxu captured Suiyang; prefect Xu Yuan, Zhang Xun, Yanzhou prefect Yao Yin, and Left Golden Canopy Guard general Nan Jiyun were all killed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，給復鳳翔五載，版授父老官。

translations.literal: On the day guihai tax and corvée were remitted for Fengxiang for five years and provisional offices were granted to elderly worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai tax and corvée were remitted for Fengxiang for five years and provisional offices were granted to elderly worthies.

sentences.zh: 遣太子太師韋見素迎上皇天帝于蜀郡。

translations.literal: Grand mentor of the crown prince Wei Jiansu was sent to welcome the Retired Emperor of Heaven from Shu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Grand mentor of the crown prince Wei Jiansu was sent to welcome the Retired Emperor of Heaven from Shu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，至自靈武，饗于太廟，哭三日。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao he returned from Lingwu, offered sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and mourned for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he returned from Lingwu, offered sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and mourned for three days.

sentences.zh: 己巳，關內節度使王思禮及安慶緒戰于絳郡，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Guannei military commissioner Wang Sili and An Qingxu fought at Jiang prefecture and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Guannei military commissioner Wang Sili and An Qingxu fought at Jiang prefecture and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，張鎬率四鎮伊西北庭行營兵馬使李嗣業、陝西節度使來瑱、河南都知兵馬使嗣吳王祗克河南郡縣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day bingzi Zhang Hao led Four Garrisons, Anxi, Beiting campaign military commissioner Li Siye, Shaanxi military commissioner Lai Tian, and Henan military affairs supervisor Prince Wu Zhi to recover Henan prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on bingzi Zhang Hao led Four Garrisons, Anxi, and Beiting campaign military commissioner Li Siye, Shaanxi military commissioner Lai Tian, and Henan military affairs supervisor Prince Wu Zhi to recover Henan prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 庚子，作九廟神主，告享于長樂殿。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi the spirit tablets of the nine temples were made and announced at Changle Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the spirit tablets of the nine temples were made and announced at Changle Hall.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，上皇天帝至自蜀郡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day bingwu the Retired Emperor of Heaven arrived from Shu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on bingwu the Retired Emperor of Heaven arrived from Shu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，苗晉卿為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Miao Jinqing was made vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Miao Jinqing was appointed vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 靈武元從、蜀郡扈從官三品以上予一子官，四品以下一子出身。

translations.literal: For Lingwu original followers and Shu entourage officials of third rank and above one son was given an office; for fourth rank and below one son was given entry into service.
translations.idiomatic: Lingwu original followers and Shu entourage officials of third rank and above were granted an office for one son; those of fourth rank and below were granted entry into service for one son.

sentences.zh: 瘞陣亡者，致祭之，給復其家二載。

translations.literal: The war dead were buried and sacrifices offered; their families were given tax and corvée remission for two years.
translations.idiomatic: The war dead were buried and sacrifices offered; their families received tax and corvée remission for two years.

sentences.zh: 免天下租、庸來歲三之一。

translations.literal: One-third of the empire's land tax and corvée for the coming year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: One-third of the empire's land tax and corvée for the coming year was remitted.

sentences.zh: 禁珠玉、寶鈿、平脫、金泥、刺繡。

translations.literal: Pearls, jade, jeweled inlay, flat-gold appliqué, gold paste, and embroidery were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Pearls, jade, jeweled inlay, flat-gold appliqué, gold paste, and embroidery were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 復諸州及官名。

translations.literal: Prefectural and official names were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural and official names were restored.

sentences.zh: 以蜀郡為南京，鳳翔郡為西京，西京為中京。

translations.literal: Shu prefecture was made the Southern Capital, Fengxiang prefecture the Western Capital, and the Western Capital the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shu was made the Southern Capital, Fengxiang the Western Capital, and the former Western Capital the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 給復潞州五載，幷鄧許滑宋五州、雍丘好畤奉先縣二載，益州三載。

translations.literal: Tax and corvée were remitted for Luzhou for five years; for Deng, Xu, Hua, Song, and Yong prefectures and Yongqiu, Hao, and Fengxian counties for two years; and for Yizhou for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Tax and corvée were remitted for Luzhou for five years; for Deng, Xu, Hua, Song, and Yong prefectures and Yongqiu, Hao, and Fengxian counties for two years; and for Yizhou for three years.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵，父老八十以上版授，加緋衣、銀魚，民酺五日。

translations.literal: Ranks, merit registers, and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials; elderly worthies eighty and above received provisional appointments with crimson robes and silver fish tally; the people were given five days of public feasting.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks, merit registers, and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials; elderly worthies eighty and older received provisional appointments with crimson robes and silver fish tally; the people were granted five days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 廣平郡王俶為太尉，進封楚王。

translations.literal: Prince of Guangping Chu was made grand marshal and advanced to Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Guangping Chu was made grand marshal and advanced to Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 苗晉卿為侍中，崔圓為中書令，李麟同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Miao Jinqing was made palace secretary; Cui Yuan was made secretariat director; Li Lin was made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Jinqing was appointed palace secretary; Cui Yuan secretariat director; and Li Lin jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 進封子南陽郡王係為趙王，新城郡王僅彭王，潁川郡王僩兗王，東陽郡王侹涇王。

translations.literal: The emperor's sons were advanced: Prince of Nanyang Xi to Prince of Zhao, Prince of Xincheng Jin to Prince of Peng, Prince of Yingchuan Xian to Prince of Yan, and Prince of Dongyang Ting to Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's sons were advanced: Prince of Nanyang Xi to Prince of Zhao, Prince of Xincheng Jin to Prince of Peng, Prince of Yingchuan Xian to Prince of Yan, and Prince of Dongyang Ting to Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 封子僙為襄王，倕𣏌王，偲召王，佋興王，侗定王。

translations.literal: The sons Qian was enfeoffed Prince of Xiang, Chui Prince of Qi, Si Prince of Shao, Zhao Prince of Xing, and Tong Prince of Ding.
translations.idiomatic: The sons Qian was enfeoffed Prince of Xiang, Chui Prince of Qi, Si Prince of Shao, Zhao Prince of Xing, and Tong Prince of Ding.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，史思明降。

translations.literal: On the day yichou Shi Siming surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Shi Siming surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬申，達奚珣等伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Daxi Xun and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Daxi Xun and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年正月戊寅，上皇天帝御宣政殿，授皇帝傳國、受命寶符，冊號曰光天文武大聖孝感皇帝。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Qianyuan on the day wuyin the Retired Emperor of Heaven presided at the Xuanzheng Hall, conferred the imperial succession and mandate talismans on the emperor, and invested him with the title Guangtian Civil and Martial Great Sage and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Qianyuan 1 on wuyin the Retired Emperor of Heaven presided at the Xuanzheng Hall, conferred the imperial succession and mandate talismans on the emperor, and invested him with the title Guangtian Civil and Martial Great Sage and Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，出宮女三千人。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou three thousand palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou three thousand palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin a grand review was held.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，安慶緒將能元皓以淄、青降，以元皓為河北招討使。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day guimao An Qingxu's general Neng Yuanhao surrendered Zi and Qing; Yuanhao was made Hebei campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on guimao An Qingxu's general Neng Yuanhao surrendered Zi and Qing; Yuanhao was made Hebei campaign commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上上皇天帝冊號曰聖皇天帝。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the Retired Emperor of Heaven was invested with the title Sage Emperor of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Retired Emperor of Heaven was invested with the title Sage Emperor of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.

sentences.zh: 贈死事及拒偽命者官。

translations.literal: Posthumous offices were granted to those who died in service and those who refused rebel commands.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous offices were granted to those who died in service and those who refused rebel commands.

sentences.zh: 成都、靈州扈從三品以上予一子官，五品以上一子出身，六品以下敍進之。

translations.literal: For Chengdu and Lingzhou entourage of third rank and above one son was given an office; for fifth rank and above one son entry into service; for sixth rank and below advancement in grade.
translations.idiomatic: For Chengdu and Lingzhou entourage of third rank and above one son was granted an office; for fifth rank and above entry into service; for sixth rank and below advancement in grade.

sentences.zh: 免陷賊州三歲稅。

translations.literal: Three years' tax from prefectures captured by rebels was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Three years' tax from prefectures captured by rebels was remitted.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、爵。

translations.literal: Ranks and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，徙封俶為成王。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiaxu Chu was transferred to Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiaxu Chu was transferred to Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立淑妃張氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the virtuous consort of the Zhang clan was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the virtuous consort of the Zhang clan was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 四月辛亥，祔神主于太廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day xinhai the spirit tablets were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on xinhai the spirit tablets were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，朝享于太廟，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin court sacrifice was offered in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the southern suburban rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin court sacrifice was offered in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the southern suburban rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大赦，賜文武官階、勳、爵，天下非租、庸毋輒役使，有能賑貧窮寵以官爵，京官九品以上言事，二王、三恪予一子官。

translations.literal: On the day yimao a general amnesty was proclaimed; ranks, merit registers, and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials; corvée other than land tax and corvée must not be levied at will throughout the empire; those who could relieve poverty and distress were rewarded with office and title; capital officials of ninth rank and above might present memorials; and one son of each of the Two Kings and Three Enfeoffed Clans was given an office.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao a general amnesty was proclaimed; ranks, merit registers, and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials; corvée beyond land tax and corvée must not be levied at will throughout the empire; those who relieved poverty and distress were rewarded with office and title; capital officials of ninth rank and above might present memorials; and one son of each of the Two Kings and Three Enfeoffed Clans was granted an office.

sentences.zh: 史思明殺范陽節度副使烏承恩以反。

translations.literal: Shi Siming killed Fanyang deputy military commissioner Wu Cheng'en in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Siming killed Fanyang deputy military commissioner Wu Cheng'en and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，張鎬罷。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day wuzi Zhang Hao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on wuzi Zhang Hao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，崔圓、李麟罷。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Cui Yuan and Li Lin were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Cui Yuan and Li Lin were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿王璵為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Grand ritualist Wang Yu was made vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Grand ritualist Wang Yu was appointed vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月，党項羌寇邊。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Tangut Qiang raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Tangut Qiang raided the border.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，招討党項使王仲昇殺拓拔戎德。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingzi campaign commissioner against the Tangut Wang Zhongsheng killed Tuoba Rongde.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingzi campaign commissioner against the Tangut Wang Zhongsheng killed Tuoba Rongde.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，郭子儀率李光弼、李嗣業、王思禮、淮西節度使魯炅、興平軍節度使李奐、滑濮節度使許叔冀、平盧兵馬使董秦、鄭蔡節度使季廣琛以討安慶緒。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Guo Ziyi led Li Guangbi, Li Siye, Wang Sili, Huaixi military commissioner Lu Jiong, Xingping military commissioner Li Huan, Hua-Pu military commissioner Xu Shuji, Pinglu military commissioner Dong Qin, and Zheng-Cai military commissioner Ji Guangchen to campaign against An Qingxu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Guo Ziyi led Li Guangbi, Li Siye, Wang Sili, Huaixi military commissioner Lu Jiong, Xingping military commissioner Li Huan, Hua-Pu military commissioner Xu Shuji, Pinglu military commissioner Dong Qin, and Zheng-Cai military commissioner Ji Guangchen against An Qingxu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大食、波斯寇廣州。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Dashi and Persia raided Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Dashi and Persia raided Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，立成王俶為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jiachen Prince of Cheng Chu was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jiachen Prince of Cheng Chu was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、爵，五品以上子為父後者勳兩轉。

translations.literal: Ranks and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials; for fifth rank and above, sons who succeeded fathers received two turns of merit register.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials; for fifth rank and above, sons who succeeded fathers received two turns of merit register.

sentences.zh: 舉忠正孝友堪東宮官者。

translations.literal: Those loyal, upright, filial, and friendly and fit for Eastern Palace office were sought.
translations.idiomatic: Those loyal, upright, filial, and friendly and fit for Eastern Palace office were sought.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，王思禮及安慶緒戰于相州，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renshen Wang Sili and An Qingxu fought at Xiangzhou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renshen Wang Sili and An Qingxu fought at Xiangzhou and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，戶部尚書李峘都統淮南、江東、江西節度使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day gengxu Minister of Revenue Li Xian was made supreme commander of Huainan, Jiangdong, and Jiangxi military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengxu Minister of Revenue Li Xian was made supreme commander of Huainan, Jiangdong, and Jiangxi military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，史思明陷魏州。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Shi Siming captured Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Shi Siming captured Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 二年正月己巳，羣臣上尊號曰乾元大聖光天文武孝感皇帝。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day jisi the multitude of officials presented the honorific title Qianyuan Great Sage Guangtian Civil and Martial and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year on jisi the officials presented the honorific title Qianyuan Great Sage Guangtian Civil and Martial and Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 郭子儀及安慶緒戰于愁思岡，敗之。

translations.idiomatic: On yihai Hou Xiyi and Chaoyi's general Li Huaixian fought at Fanyang and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 寶應元年建寅月甲申，追冊靖德太子琮為皇帝，妃竇氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoying, Establishing-yin month, on the day jiashen the posthumous investiture of Jingde Crown Prince Cong as emperor and his consort of the Dou clan as empress was pursued.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoying 1, Establishing-yin month, on jiashen Crown Prince Jingde Cong was posthumously invested as emperor and his consort of the Dou clan as empress.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，葬王公妃主遇害者。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou princes, princesses, and consorts who met violent death were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou princes, princesses, and consorts who met violent death were buried.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，盜發敬陵、惠陵。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Jing Mausoleum and Hui Mausoleum were robbed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Jing Mausoleum and Hui Mausoleum were robbed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李光弼克許州。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Li Guangbi captured Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Guangbi captured Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃請和。

translations.literal: Tubo requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: Tubo requested peace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，史朝義陷營州。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Shi Chaoyi captured Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Shi Chaoyi captured Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 建卯月辛亥，大赦。

translations.literal: In Establishing-mao month on the day xinhai a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In Establishing-mao month on xinhai a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、爵。

translations.literal: Ranks and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 五品以上清望及郎官、御史薦流人有行業情可矜者。

translations.literal: Fifth rank and above of clear reputation and court gentlemen, remonstrators, and censors were to recommend exiles of conduct worthy of compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth rank and above of clear reputation and court gentlemen, remonstrators, and censors were to recommend exiles whose conduct merited compassion.

sentences.zh: 停貢鷹、鷂、狗、豹。

translations.literal: Tribute of hawks, falcons, dogs, and leopards was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute of hawks, falcons, dogs, and leopards was suspended.

sentences.zh: 以京兆府為上都，河南府為東都，鳳翔府為西都，江陵府為南都，太原府為北都。

translations.literal: Jingzhao prefecture was made the Superior Capital, Henan the Eastern Capital, Fengxiang the Western Capital, Jiangling the Southern Capital, and Taiyuan the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao was made the Superior Capital, Henan the Eastern Capital, Fengxiang the Western Capital, Jiangling the Southern Capital, and Taiyuan the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬子，羌、渾、奴剌寇梁州。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the Qiang, Hun, and slave Ci raided Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Qiang, Hun, and slave Ci raided Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，河東軍亂，殺其節度使鄧景山，都知兵馬使辛雲京自稱節度使。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Hedong troops mutinied, killed military commissioner Deng Jingshan, and military affairs supervisor Xin Yunjing styled himself military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Hedong troops mutinied, killed military commissioner Deng Jingshan, and military affairs supervisor Xin Yunjing styled himself military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，河中軍亂，殺李國貞及其節度使荔非元禮。

translations.literal: On the day yichou Hezhong troops mutinied and killed Li Guozhen and military commissioner Li Feiyuanli.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Hezhong troops mutinied and killed Li Guozhen and military commissioner Li Feiyuanli.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，淮西節度使王仲昇及史朝義將謝欽讓戰于申州，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Huaixi military commissioner Wang Zhongsheng and Shi Chaoyi's general Xie Qinrang fought at Shen prefecture and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Huaixi military commissioner Wang Zhongsheng and Shi Chaoyi's general Xie Qinrang fought at Shen prefecture and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 庚午，郭子儀知朔方、河中、北庭、潞儀澤沁節度行營，興平、定國軍兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Guo Ziyi was made acting Shuofang, Hezhong, Beiting, and Lu-Yi-Ze-Qin campaign commissioner and deputy supreme commander of Xingping and Dingguo armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Guo Ziyi was made acting Shuofang, Hezhong, Beiting, and Lu-Yi-Ze-Qin campaign commissioner and deputy supreme commander of Xingping and Dingguo armies.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鄜州刺史成公意及党項戰，敗之。

translations.literal: In Establishing-chen month on the day renwu Fuzhou prefect Cheng Gongyi and the Tangut fought and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In Establishing-chen month on renwu Fuzhou prefect Cheng Gongyi and the Tangut fought and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 建辰月壬午，大赦，官吏聽納贓免罪，左降官及流人罰鎮効力者還之。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu a general amnesty was proclaimed; officials were permitted to pay bribes to avoid punishment; demoted officials and exiles performing penal labor were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a general amnesty was proclaimed; officials were permitted to pay fines to avoid punishment; demoted officials and exiles performing penal labor were returned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，奴剌寇梁州。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu the slave Ci raided Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the slave Ci raided Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，蕭華罷。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Xiao Hua was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xiao Hua was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎元載同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Yuan Zai was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Revenue Yuan Zai was appointed Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 建巳月庚戌，史朝義寇澤州，刺史李抱玉敗之。

translations.literal: In Establishing-si month on the day gengxu Shi Chaoyi raided Ze prefecture; prefect Li Baoyu defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In Establishing-si month on gengxu Shi Chaoyi raided Ze prefecture; prefect Li Baoyu defeated him.

sentences.zh: 壬子，楚州獻定國寶玉十有三。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Chuzhou presented thirteen jade objects of the Dingguo treasure.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Chuzhou presented thirteen jade objects of the Dingguo treasure.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，聖皇天帝崩。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin the Sage Emperor of Heaven died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Sage Emperor of Heaven died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the crown prince supervised the state.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the crown prince supervised the state.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元年為寶應元年，復以正月為歲首，建巳月為四月。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; the era name was changed to Baoying 1; the first month was restored as the year's beginning and Establishing-si month became the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed; the era name was changed to Baoying 1; the first month was restored as the year's beginning and Establishing-si month became the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，閑廄使李輔國、飛龍廄副使程元振遷皇后于別殿，殺越王係、兗王僩。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Inner Stables commissioner Li Fuguo and Flying Dragon Stables deputy Cheng Yuanzhen moved the empress to a separate palace and killed Prince of Yue Xi and Prince of Yan Xian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Inner Stables commissioner Li Fuguo and Flying Dragon Stables deputy Cheng Yuanzhen moved the empress to a separate palace and killed Prince of Yue Xi and Prince of Yan Xian.

sentences.zh: 是夜，皇帝崩于長生殿，年五十二。

translations.literal: That night the emperor died in the Hall of Long Life at age fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: That night the emperor died in the Hall of Long Life at age fifty-two.

sentences.zh: 代宗代宗睿文孝武皇帝諱豫，肅宗長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Daizong, Emperor Daizong the Sagacious Civil and Martial and Filial, taboo name Yu, was the eldest son of Suzong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daizong, posthumously honored as the Sagacious Civil and Martial and Filial, bore the taboo name Yu and was the eldest son of Suzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰章敬皇后吳氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Zhangjing of the Wu clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zhangjing, née Wu.

sentences.zh: 玄宗諸孫百餘人，代宗最長，為嫡皇孫。

translations.literal: Among Xuanzong's grandsons numbering more than a hundred, Daizong was the eldest and the legitimate imperial grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Among Xuanzong's more than a hundred grandsons, Daizong was the eldest legitimate imperial grandson.

sentences.zh: 聰明寬厚，喜慍不形於色，而好學強記，通易象。

translations.literal: He was intelligent, generous, and magnanimous; pleasure and anger did not show on his face; he was fond of learning with a strong memory and mastered the Changes and omens.
translations.idiomatic: He was intelligent, generous, and magnanimous; pleasure and anger never showed on his face; he loved learning and had a powerful memory, and mastered the Changes and omens.

sentences.zh: 初名俶，封廣平郡王。

translations.literal: His original name was Chu; he was enfeoffed Prince of Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: He was first named Chu and enfeoffed Prince of Guangping.

sentences.zh: 安祿山反，玄宗幸蜀，肅宗留討賊，代宗常從於兵間。

translations.literal: When An Lushan rebelled Xuanzong went to Shu; Suzong remained to suppress the rebels, and Daizong often followed him in the army.
translations.idiomatic: When An Lushan rebelled Xuanzong fled to Shu; Suzong remained to suppress the rebels, and Daizong often followed him on campaign.

sentences.zh: 肅宗已即位，郭子儀等兵討安慶緒，未克。

translations.literal: After Suzong had taken the throne, Guo Ziyi and others campaigned against An Qingxu but had not yet captured him.
translations.idiomatic: After Suzong had taken the throne, Guo Ziyi and others campaigned against An Qingxu but had not yet defeated him.

sentences.zh: 肅宗在岐，至德二載九月，以廣平郡王為天下兵馬元帥，率朔方、安西、回紇、南蠻、大食等兵二十萬以進討，百官送于朝堂，過闕而下，步出木馬門，然後復騎。

translations.literal: Suzong was at Qi; in the ninth month of the second year of Zhide he was made supreme commander of all armies and led Shuofang, Anxi, Uyghur, Nanman, and Dashi troops numbering two hundred thousand to advance; the hundred officials saw him off at the court hall; he passed the palace gate and dismounted, walked out the Wooden Horse Gate, then mounted again.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong was at Qi; in the ninth month of Zhide 2 he was made supreme commander of all armies and led two hundred thousand Shuofang, Anxi, Uyghur, Nanman, and Dashi troops to advance; officials saw him off at the court hall; he passed the palace gate and dismounted, walked out the Wooden Horse Gate, then mounted again.

sentences.zh: 以安西、北庭行營節度使李嗣業為前軍，朔方、河西、隴右節度使郭子儀為中軍，關內行營節度使王思禮為後軍，屯于香積寺。

translations.literal: Anxi and Beiting campaign military commissioner Li Siye was vanguard; Shuofang, Hexi, and Longyou military commissioner Guo Ziyi central army; Guannei campaign military commissioner Wang Sili rear guard; they encamped at Xiangji Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi and Beiting campaign military commissioner Li Siye led the vanguard; Shuofang, Hexi, and Longyou military commissioner Guo Ziyi the center; Guannei campaign military commissioner Wang Sili the rear; they encamped at Xiangji Temple.

sentences.zh: 敗賊將安守忠，斬首六萬級。

translations.literal: They defeated rebel general An Shouzhong and beheaded sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: They defeated rebel general An Shouzhong and beheaded sixty thousand.

sentences.zh: 賊將張通儒守長安，聞守忠敗，棄城走，遂克京城，乃留思禮屯于苑中，代宗率大軍以東。

translations.literal: Rebel general Zhang Tongru held Chang'an; hearing Shouzhong's defeat he abandoned the city and fled; the capital was then captured; Sili was left to encamp in the park while Daizong led the great army east.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel general Zhang Tongru held Chang'an; hearing of Shouzhong's defeat he abandoned the city and fled; the capital was captured; Sili was left to encamp in the park while Daizong led the main army east.

sentences.zh: 安慶緒遣其將嚴莊拒于陝州，代宗及子儀、嗣業戰陝西，大敗之，慶緒奔于河北，遂克東都。

translations.literal: An Qingxu sent his general Yan Zhuang to resist at Shanzhou; Daizong with Ziyi and Siye fought in western Shan and inflicted a great defeat; Qingxu fled to Hebei; the Eastern Capital was captured.
translations.idiomatic: An Qingxu sent his general Yan Zhuang to resist at Shanzhou; Daizong with Ziyi and Siye fought in western Shan and won a great victory; Qingxu fled to Hebei and the Eastern Capital was captured.

sentences.zh: 肅宗還京師。

translations.literal: Suzong returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月，進封楚王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was advanced to Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was advanced to Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年三月，徙封成王。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Qianyuan he was transferred to Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Qianyuan 1 he was transferred to Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 四月，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 初，太子生之歲，豫州獻嘉禾，於是以為祥，及更名豫。

translations.literal: At first, in the year the crown prince was born, Yuzhou presented auspicious grain; therefore it was taken as a portent, and when his name was changed it became Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the year the crown prince was born Yuzhou presented auspicious grain; this was taken as a portent, and when his name was changed it became Yu.

sentences.zh: 肅宗去上元三年號，止稱元年，月以斗所建辰為名。

translations.literal: Suzong dropped the Shangyuan third-year era name and used only First Year; months were named for the lodge the Dipper established.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong dropped the Shangyuan third-year era name and used only First Year; months were named for the lodge the Dipper established.

sentences.zh: 元年建巳月，肅宗寢疾，及詔皇太子監國。

translations.literal: In the First Year, Establishing-si month, Suzong fell gravely ill and ordered the crown prince to supervise the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the First Year, Establishing-si month, Suzong fell gravely ill and ordered the crown prince to supervise the state.

sentences.zh: 而楚州獻定國寶十有三，因曰：「楚者，太子之所封，今天降寶於楚，宜以建元。

translations.literal: Chuzhou presented thirteen objects of the Dingguo treasure; therefore it was said: "Chu is what the crown prince was enfeoffed; now treasure descends on Chu—Establishing should be the era name."
translations.idiomatic: Chuzhou presented thirteen objects of the Dingguo treasure; it was said, "Chu is the crown prince's fief; now treasure descends on Chu—the era should be Establishing."

sentences.zh: 」乃以元年為寶應元年。

translations.literal: The First Year was therefore changed to Baoying 1.
translations.idiomatic: The First Year was therefore changed to Baoying 1.

sentences.zh: 肅宗張皇后惡李輔國，欲圖之，召問太子，太子不許，乃與越王係謀之。

translations.literal: Suzong's Empress Zhang hated Li Fuguo and wished to plot against him; she asked the crown prince, who refused; she then plotted with Prince of Yue Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong's Empress Zhang hated Li Fuguo and wished to destroy him; she consulted the crown prince, who refused; she then plotted with Prince of Yue Xi.

sentences.zh: 肅宗疾革。

translations.literal: Suzong's illness became critical.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong's illness became critical.

sentences.zh: 四月丁卯，皇后與係將召太子入宮，飛龍副使程元振得其謀，以告輔國。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dingmao the empress and Xi were about to summon the crown prince into the palace; Flying Dragon deputy Cheng Yuanzhen learned the plot and informed Fuguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dingmao the empress and Xi were about to summon the crown prince into the palace; Flying Dragon deputy Cheng Yuanzhen learned the plot and informed Fuguo.

sentences.zh: 輔國止太子無入，率兵入，殺係及兗王僩，幽皇后于別殿。

translations.literal: Fuguo stopped the crown prince from entering, led troops in, killed Xi and Prince of Yan Xian, and confined the empress in a separate palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fuguo barred the crown prince from entering, led troops in, killed Xi and Prince of Yan Xian, and confined the empress in a separate palace.

sentences.zh: 是夕，肅宗崩，乃迎太子見羣臣於九仙門。

translations.literal: That evening Suzong died; the crown prince was then welcomed to meet the officials at the Nine Immortals Gate.
translations.idiomatic: That evening Suzong died; the crown prince was then welcomed to meet the officials at the Nine Immortals Gate.

sentences.zh: 明日，發喪。

translations.literal: The next day mourning began.
translations.idiomatic: The next day mourning began.

sentences.zh: 己巳，即皇帝位于柩前。

translations.literal: On the day jisi he took the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he ascended the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，始聽政。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou he began to hear affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he began to hear affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，奉節郡王适為天下兵馬元帥，郭子儀罷副元帥。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Prince of Fengyi Shi was made supreme commander of all armies; Guo Ziyi was dismissed as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Prince of Fengyi Shi was made supreme commander of all armies; Guo Ziyi was dismissed as deputy.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，進封适為魯王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Shi was advanced to Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Shi was advanced to Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，李輔國為司空。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day renwu Li Fuguo was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on renwu Li Fuguo was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，追尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin his mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin his mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丙申，李光弼及史朝義戰于宋州，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Li Guangbi and Shi Chaoyi fought at Song prefecture and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Guangbi and Shi Chaoyi fought at Song prefecture and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 刺史予一子官，賜文武官階、爵，子為父後者勳一轉。

translations.literal: Prefects were granted an office for one son; ranks and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials; sons who succeeded fathers received one turn of merit register.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects were granted an office for one son; ranks and titles were bestowed on civil and military officials; sons who succeeded fathers received one turn of merit register.

sentences.zh: 免民逋租宿負。

translations.literal: Arrears of land tax and old debts were remitted for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears of land tax and old debts were remitted for the people.

sentences.zh: 進封子益昌郡王邈為鄭王，延慶郡王迥韓王。

translations.literal: The sons Miao and Hui were advanced to Prince of Zheng and Prince of Han.
translations.idiomatic: The sons Miao and Hui were advanced to Prince of Zheng and Prince of Han.

sentences.zh: 追復庶人王氏為皇后，瑛、瑤、琚皆復其封號。

translations.literal: The commoner Wang was posthumously restored as empress; Ying, Yao, and Ju all had their titles restored.
translations.idiomatic: The deposed Empress Wang was posthumously restored; Ying, Yao, and Ju all had their titles restored.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，追廢皇后張氏、越王係、兗王僩皆為庶人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day xinhai the deposed Empress Zhang, Prince of Yue Xi, and Prince of Yan Xian were all reduced to commoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinhai the deposed Empress Zhang, Prince of Yue Xi, and Prince of Yan Xian were all reduced to commoners.

sentences.zh: 七月乙酉，殺山南東道節度使裴茙。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day yiyou Shannan East military commissioner Pei Mao was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on yiyou Shannan East military commissioner Pei Mao was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，劍南西川兵馬使徐知道反。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Jiannan West Sichuan military commissioner Xu Zhidao rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Jiannan West Sichuan military commissioner Xu Zhidao rebelled.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，知道伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiwei Zhidao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiwei Zhidao was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，台州人袁鼂反。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Taizhou man Yuan Chao rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Taizhou man Yuan Chao rebelled.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，徙封适為雍王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Shi was transferred to Prince of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Shi was transferred to Prince of Yong.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，鳳州刺史呂日將及党項羌戰于三嗟谷，敗之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day wuzi Fengzhou prefect Lü Rijiang and Tangut Qiang fought at Sanjie Valley and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wuzi Fengzhou prefect Lü Rijiang and Tangut Qiang fought at Sanjie Valley and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，回紇請助戰。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen the Uyghurs requested to assist in the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Uyghurs requested to assist in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day renyin a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a grand review was held.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，袁鼂陷信州。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Yuan Chao captured Xin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yuan Chao captured Xin prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯，陷溫、明二州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day yimao he captured Wen and Ming prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on yimao he captured Wen and Ming prefectures.

sentences.zh: 詔浙江水旱，百姓重困，州縣勿輒科率，民疫死不能葬者為瘞之。

translations.literal: An edict said that with flood and drought in Zhejiang the people were heavily distressed; prefectures and counties must not levy at will; those who died of plague and could not be buried were to be interred.

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Prince of Yong Shi campaigned against Shi Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Prince of Yong Shi campaigned against Shi Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，盜殺李輔國。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Li Fuguo was murdered.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Fuguo was murdered.

translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Prince of Yong Shi captured Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，敗史朝義于橫水，克河陽、東都，史朝義將張獻誠以汴州降。

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Chaoyi was defeated at Hengshui; Heyang and the Eastern Capital were captured; Chaoyi's general Zhang Xianzheng surrendered Bian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，朝義將薛嵩以相、衞、洺、邢四州降。

translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on dinghai Chaoyi's general Xue Song surrendered Xiang, Wei, Ming, and Xing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，朝義將張忠志以趙、定、深、恆、易五州降。

translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Chaoyi's general Zhang Zhongzhi surrendered Zhao, Ding, Shen, Heng, and Yi prefectures.

translations.idiomatic: On jihai Shuofang campaign military commissioner Pugu Huai'en was made deputy supreme commander of Shuofang and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，太府左藏庫火。

translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jiyou the Left Treasury of the Court of the Imperial Treasury caught fire.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，瘞京城內外暴骨。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen exposed bones within and outside the capital were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen exposed bones within and outside the capital were buried.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，李光弼及袁鼂戰于衢州，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Li Guangbi and Yuan Chao fought at Qu prefecture and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Guangbi and Yuan Chao fought at Qu prefecture and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，舒州人楊昭反，殺其刺史劉秋子。

translations.idiomatic: That year Shuzhou man Yang Zhao rebelled and killed his prefect Liu Qiuzi.

translations.literal: The Xiyuan barbarians rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiyuan barbarians rebelled.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇秦、成、渭三州。

translations.literal: Tubo raided Qin, Cheng, and Wei prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Tubo raided Qin, Cheng, and Wei prefectures.

sentences.zh: 廣德元年正月癸未，京兆尹劉晏為吏部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Guangde 1 on guimao Jingzhao intendant Liu Yan was made Minister of the Civil Service and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Shi Chaoyi killed himself; his general Li Huaixian surrendered Youzhou; Tian Chengsi surrendered Weizhou.

translations.idiomatic: On renyin mausoleum commissioner and Shannan East military commissioner Lai Tian was guilty and executed.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiachen Shannan East military commissioner Liang Chongyi entered Xiangzhou from Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，李光弼及袁鼂戰，敗之。

translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Guangbi and Yuan Chao fought and defeated him.

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Supreme Filial Emperor of the Great Brightness of the Supreme Way was buried at Tailing.

translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Tangut Qiang raided Tong prefecture; Guo Ziyi defeated them at Huangdui Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Civil and Martial, Great Sage and Great Proclaiming Filial Emperor was buried at Jianling.

translations.literal: In the sixth month Tonghua military commissioner Li Huairang killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Tonghua military commissioner Li Huairang killed himself.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，羣臣上尊號曰寶應元聖文武孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day renyin the officials presented the honorific title Baoying Sagacious Civil and Martial and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on renyin the officials presented the honorific title Baoying Sagacious Civil and Martial and Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，大赦，改元。

translations.idiomatic: On renzi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.

translations.idiomatic: where the Uyghur campaign passed, this year's rent was remitted.

translations.literal: Ranks and merit registers were bestowed on inner and outer officials.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks and merit registers were bestowed on inner and outer officials.

translations.idiomatic: Merit iron tallies were given to meritorious ministers, their names stored in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and their images painted in Lingyan Pavilion.

translations.idiomatic: Tubo captured the prefectures of Longyou.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Pugu Huai'en rebelled.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on renyin Pei Zunqing was sent to console Pugu Huai'en at Fenzhou.

translations.idiomatic: On yichou Jing prefect Gao Hui rebelled and submitted to Tubo.

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day gengwu Tubo captured Bin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on gengwu Tubo captured Bin prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On xinwei they raided Fengtian and Wugong; the capital was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 壬申，雍王适為關內兵馬元帥，郭子儀副之。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Prince of Yong Shi was made Guannei military commander; Guo Ziyi was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Prince of Yong Shi was made Guannei military commander with Guo Ziyi as deputy.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，渭北行營兵馬使呂日將及吐蕃戰于盩厔，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou Weibei campaign military commissioner Lü Rijiang and Tubo fought at Zhouzhi and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Weibei campaign military commissioner Lü Rijiang and Tubo fought at Zhouzhi and defeated them.

translations.literal: On the day yihai they fought again at Zhouzhi and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai they fought again at Zhouzhi and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 丙子，如陝州。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi he went to Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he went to Shan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，次華陰。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou he halted at Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he halted at Huayin.

sentences.zh: 豐王珙有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Prince of Feng Wang was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Feng Wang was guilty and executed.

translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Tubo captured the capital and installed Prince of Guangwu Chenghong as emperor.

translations.literal: On the day xinsi he halted at Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he halted at Shan prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: Gaoyu of the Five Valleys in the southern mountains rebelled.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，廣州市舶使呂太一反，逐其節度使張休。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renyin Guangzhou maritime trade commissioner Lü Taiyi rebelled and expelled military commissioner Zhang Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renyin Guangzhou maritime trade commissioner Lü Taiyi rebelled and expelled military commissioner Zhang Xiu.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，劉晏宣慰上都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day xinwei Liu Yan was sent to console the Superior Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on xinwei Liu Yan was sent to console the Superior Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲午，至自陝州。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu he returned from Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he returned from Shan prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Miao Jinqing and Pei Zunqing were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 檢校禮部尚書李峴為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.idiomatic: Acting Minister of Rites Li Xian was appointed vice director of the gate and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙申，放承宏于華州。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Chenghong was released at Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Chenghong was released at Hua prefecture.

translations.literal: Tubo captured Song and Wei prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Tubo captured Song and Wei prefectures.

translations.idiomatic: The Xiyuan barbarians captured Dao prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year on bingwu an edict sought those fit for censor, remonstrator, prefect, and magistrate.

translations.literal: On the day yimao Prince of Yong Shi was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Prince of Yong Shi was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，劉晏、李峴罷。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Liu Yan and Li Xian were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Liu Yan and Li Xian were dismissed.

translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi was additionally made deputy supreme commander of Hedong.

translations.idiomatic: On jichou a general amnesty was proclaimed.

translations.idiomatic: Ranks and titles were bestowed on inner and outer officials;

translations.idiomatic: for Baoying meritorious ministers of third rank and above an office for one son and one additional title, the rest two turns of rank and merit register; for fifth rank and above sons who succeeded fathers, two turns of merit register.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinchou Henan prefecture received tax and corvée remission for two years.

sentences.zh: 甲子，盛王琦薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Prince of Sheng Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Prince of Sheng Qi died.

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiawu inlay of pearls and kingfisher feathers was forbidden.

translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Luo River overflowed.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on dingmao a star fell at Fen prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Guangbi died.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingyin Wang Jin was made palace secretary and supreme commander of Henan, Huainan, and Shannan East campaign affairs.

translations.literal: On the day renshen Wang Jin was dismissed as palace secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Jin was dismissed as palace secretary.

translations.idiomatic: On guisi Tubo raided Bin prefecture; Binning military commissioner Bai Xiaode defeated them at Yilu.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiwei Jiannan military commissioner Yan Wu and Tubo fought at Dangou Fortress and defeated them.

translations.idiomatic: That autumn there were ray-finned fish.

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day bingyin Tubo raided Bin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on bingyin Tubo raided Bin prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On dingmao they raided Fengtian; the capital was placed under martial law.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yan Wu captured Tubo's Yanchuan Fortress.
