translations.literal: On the day guisi an edict ordered remonstrators presenting sealed memorials without time limit; those discussing affairs at the side gate might memorialize face to face; officials of sixth rank and above presenting business in the box need not submit duplicate chapters.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi an edict ordered remonstrators to present sealed memorials without time limit; those discussing affairs at the side gate might memorialize face to face; officials of sixth rank and above presenting business in the memorial box need not submit duplicate chapters.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，吐蕃寇黎、雅二州，崔寧敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou Tubo raided Li and Ya prefectures; Cui Ning defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Tubo raided Li and Ya prefectures; Cui Ning defeated them.

sentences.zh: 是月，金州人卓英璘反。

translations.literal: That month Jin prefecture man Zhuo Yinglin rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jin prefecture man Zhuo Yinglin rebelled.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，英璘伏誅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day yisi Yinglin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on yisi Yinglin was executed.

sentences.zh: 給復金州二年。

translations.literal: Jin prefecture was given tax and corvée remission for two years.
translations.idiomatic: Jin prefecture received tax and corvée remission for two years.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以旱降京師死罪，流以下原之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei because of drought capital crimes were reduced and exile and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei because of drought capital crimes were reduced and those exiled or below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，楊綰薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jisi Yang Wan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jisi Yang Wan died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔尚書、御史大夫、左右丞、侍郎舉任刺史者。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi an edict ordered ministers, censors-in-chief, left and right assistants, vice ministers, and directors to recommend those fit for prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict ordered ministers, censors-in-chief, left and right assistants, vice ministers, and directors to recommend those fit for prefect.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，吐蕃寇坊州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengwu Tubo raided Fang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengwu Tubo raided Fang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是秋，河溢。

translations.literal: That autumn the Yellow River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Yellow River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，山南西道節度使張獻恭及吐蕃戰于岷州，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renzi Shannan West military commissioner Zhang Xiangong and Tubo fought at Min prefecture and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renzi Shannan West military commissioner Zhang Xiangong and Tubo fought at Min prefecture and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，崔寧及吐蕃戰于西山，敗之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dinghai Cui Ning and Tubo fought in the western hills and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dinghai Cui Ning and Tubo fought in the western hills and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，恆、定、趙三州地震。

translations.literal: That year Heng, Ding, and Zhao prefectures were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That year Heng, Ding, and Zhao prefectures were shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 冬，無雪。

translations.literal: In winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: In winter there was no snow.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月戊辰，回紇寇幷州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, first month, on the day wuchen the Uyghurs raided Bing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, first month, on wuchen the Uyghurs raided Bing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，河東節度留後鮑防及回紇戰于陽曲，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou Hedong acting commissioner Bao Fang and the Uyghurs fought at Yangqu and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Hedong acting commissioner Bao Fang and the Uyghurs fought at Yangqu and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，代州刺史張光晟及回紇戰于羊虎谷，敗之。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day gengchen Daizhou prefect Zhang Guangcheng and the Uyghurs fought at Yanghu Valley and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on gengchen Daizhou prefect Zhang Guangcheng and the Uyghurs fought at Yanghu Valley and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 四月甲辰，吐蕃寇靈州，常謙光敗之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiachen Tubo raided Ling prefecture; Chang Qian'guang defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiachen Tubo raided Ling prefecture; Chang Qian'guang defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十月己丑，禁京畿持兵器捕獵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jichou hunting with weapons within the capital precincts was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jichou hunting with weapons within the capital precincts was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 是歲，郴州黃芩山崩。

translations.literal: That year Chen prefecture's Huangqin Mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chen prefecture's Huangqin Mountain collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月癸未，魏博節度使田承嗣卒，其兄子悅自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, second month, on the day guimao Weibo military commissioner Tian Chengsi died; his nephew's son Yue styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, second month, on guimao Weibo military commissioner Tian Chengsi died; his nephew's son Yue styled himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，汴宋將李希烈逐其節度使李忠臣，自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day dingwei Bian-Song general Li Xilie expelled military commissioner Li Zhongchen and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on dingwei Bian-Song general Li Xilie expelled military commissioner Li Zhongchen and styled himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，不豫，詔皇太子監國。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day xinyou he was indisposed and ordered the crown prince to supervise the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinyou he was indisposed and ordered the crown prince to supervise the state.

sentences.zh: 是夕，皇帝崩于紫宸內殿，年五十三。

translations.literal: That evening the emperor died in the Purple Forbidden Inner Hall at age fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: That evening the emperor died in the Purple Forbidden Inner Hall at age fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 【贊】贊曰：天寶之亂，大盜遽起，天子出奔。

translations.literal: [Appraisal] The appraisal says: At the Tianbao disorder the great bandit suddenly arose and the Son of Heaven fled.
translations.idiomatic: [Appraisal] The appraisal says: At the Tianbao disorders the great rebel suddenly arose and the Son of Heaven fled the capital.

sentences.zh: 方是時，肅宗以皇太子治兵討賊，真得其職矣！

translations.literal: At that time Suzong as crown prince drilled troops to suppress the bandits—truly he held the proper role!
translations.idiomatic: At that time Suzong as crown prince drilled troops to suppress the bandits—truly he held the proper role!

sentences.zh: 然以僖宗之時，唐之威德在人，紀綱未壞，孰與天寶之際？

translations.literal: Yet in Xizong's time Tang's prestige and virtue still lived in men's hearts and discipline was not yet broken—how did that compare with the Tianbao era?
translations.idiomatic: Yet in Xizong's time Tang's prestige and virtue still lived in men's hearts and discipline was not yet broken—how did that compare with the Tianbao era?

sentences.zh: 而僖宗在蜀，諸鎮之兵糺合勠力，遂破黃巢而復京師。

translations.literal: Yet Xizong was in Shu and the various commands' troops united in concerted effort, broke Huang Chao, and recovered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Xizong was in Shu while the various commands' troops united in concerted effort, broke Huang Chao, and recovered the capital.

sentences.zh: 由是言之，肅宗雖不即尊位，亦可以破賊矣。

translations.literal: From this it may be said that even if Suzong had not immediately taken the exalted throne, he still could have broken the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: From this it may be said that even if Suzong had not immediately taken the throne, he still could have broken the rebels.

sentences.zh: 蓋自高祖以來，三遜于位以授其子，而獨睿宗上畏天戒，發於誠心，若高祖、玄宗，豈其志哉！

translations.literal: From Gaozu onward there had been three abdications in favor of sons, but only Ruizong, in awe of heaven's warning, acted from sincere heart—as for Gaozong and Xuanzong, was that their intent?
translations.idiomatic: From Gaozu onward the throne had been yielded three times to sons, but only Ruizong, in awe of heaven's warning, acted from sincere heart—as for Gaozong and Xuanzong, was that truly their intent?

sentences.zh: 代宗之時，餘孽猶在，平亂守成，蓋亦中材之主也！

translations.literal: In Daizong's time remnants still remained; in pacifying disorder and preserving the achievement he was roughly a ruler of middling talent!
translations.idiomatic: In Daizong's time remnants still remained; in pacifying disorder and preserving what had been won he was roughly a ruler of middling talent!
